item.title: 'Likweli': A new monkey species discovered in the Congo Basin
item.description:
📝 The identification of Likweli as distinct from other Colobus monkey species is supported by evidence drawn from its physical traits, genetics, and vocalizations. VIDEO: Likweli lives high in the treetops of Lomami National Park in Congo. In April 2021, ICCN officers confiscated three deceased Likweli specimens from hunters within the Lomami National Park buffer zone.
🔗 Read more: https://news.yale.edu/2026/07/15/meet-likweli-new-monkey-species-discovered-congo-basin
